description: Fires a burst of 1 to 64 pulses each time it is triggered, timed by its own jittering clock or by one you patch in

params.text: Sets how many pulses make up the burst, 1 to 64
Sets the rate of the internal clock: 1Hz to 32Hz with RANGE at S, and 16Hz to 1024Hz with RANGE at F
Sets how far the rate voltage moves the internal clock, and in which direction; at full travel each volt doubles or halves the rate
F runs the internal clock from 16Hz to 1024Hz, S from 1Hz to 32Hz
ON lets a new trigger interrupt a burst and start it again; OFF makes a trigger take effect only once the burst has finished
Sets how far the pulse count voltage moves the number of pulses, and in which direction; at full travel 10V covers the whole 1 to 64 range
Starts a burst as though a trigger had arrived
Sets the chance of each pulse in the burst firing, 100% fully clockwise; a pulse that does not fire is counted anyway, so the burst can end up with fewer pulses than the number set
Sets how far the pulse probability voltage moves the chance of a pulse firing, and in which direction, from -1 to +1
Shortens each internal clock cycle by a random amount, reaching up to 32 times the set rate at full travel; with a cable in the jitter input the knob attenuates that voltage instead
Sets the chance of each internal clock cycle reaching the pulse section, 100% fully clockwise; a cycle dropped here does not count, so the burst keeps its full number of pulses but spreads them out
Sets how far the clock probability voltage moves that chance, and in which direction, from -1 to +1

inputs.text: Takes an outside clock in place of the internal one; the burst then starts on the next rising edge here rather than at the trigger, and jitter no longer applies
Moves the rate of the internal clock, by the amount and direction set on the rate attenuverter
A rising edge here starts a burst
Sets how far the pulse count voltage moves the number of pulses, and in which direction; at full travel 10V covers the whole 1 to 64 range
Moves the chance of each pulse firing, by the amount and direction set on the pulse probability attenuverter
Varies how much the internal clock cycles are shortened, 0-10V scaled by the jitter knob; an external clock is left alone
Moves the chance of a clock cycle reaching the pulse section, by the amount and direction set on the clock probability attenuverter

outputs.text: The pulses of the burst at 10V, each one as wide as the clock pulse that produced it
A 1ms 10V trigger at the start of each burst
10V from the start of the burst until the end of its last pulse
A 1ms 10V trigger when a burst finishes
Carries the clock the burst is counted against at 10V: the internal clock with its jitter, or the external clock when one is patched

menu: Bypass probability on clock output — sends every internal clock cycle to the CLOCK output whatever the clock probability knob is set to, leaving that probability applied to the pulse section

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
